settings.heading: A sunny little home brand for cats
settings.definition: A cat sitting tucked up with its paws hidden under its chest, like it plans to stay until the sun moves. That is the whole warmth of our name.
settings.body:
Sunny Loaf Co. makes thoughtfully chosen home essentials for American cat owners: window perches, beds, and everyday pieces for cats who loaf in the sun. We pick a few things worth bringing into a real home, photograph them honestly, and ship them from the US with tracking.

No bakery here, just cats, sunny windows, and the people who arrange the furniture around them.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship from the US. Please allow 1–3 business days to process, then typically 5–10 business days for delivery. Edit this to match your real times.

settings.question: How can I reach you?
settings.answer: Email hello@sunnyloafco.com and we'll reply within one business day.
